headline: AI‑led deals lifted many firms, but overall revenue growth slowed and profit margins diverged.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI revenue contributions were highlighted across the board, driving higher margins for some and offsetting slower top‑line growth for others. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech, while several peers kept guidance unchanged. Profit performance was mixed, with strong jumps at HCLTech and Coforge but declines at Infosys, Wipro and Persistent.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and deal wins were cited by most companies, boosting top‑line growth for high‑growth peers and supporting profit expansion at HCLTech.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins improved at high‑growth firms like Coforge and TCS, while lower‑growth firms saw flat or modest margins.

themes.title: Guidance shifts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 outlook; Wipro gave a short‑term constant‑currency range.

themes.title: Dividend actions
themes.detail: Several firms announced higher interim dividends, reflecting confidence in cash flow despite mixed earnings.
